title: Common refinements for already compactifiable morphisms over arbitrary schemes
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with separatedness and finite type as in [def-weil-proper-morphism] and [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], admitting at least one compactification, a factorization $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y$ with $j$ a quasi-compact open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] and $p$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Consider the category of these compactifications with proper $Y$-maps $u:\overline X_1\to\overline X_2$ satisfying $uj_1=j_2$ as arrows [lem-nagata-refinements-form-category]. This category is cofiltered: every pair of objects has a common refinement, and every pair of parallel arrows is equalized by a refinement. No quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness assumption on $Y$ is made. For any $g:Y'\to Y$, base change sends objects and arrows to compactifications and refinements of $X\times_Y Y'\to Y'$, preserves identities and compositions, and carries a common refinement or equalizer diagram to such a diagram. Base changes here are formed by fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product].
